name: Hasumi
source: Hasumi is a shy and quiet girl who usually keeps to herself. She is always very polite and respectful towards others, and has a hard time talking to people she doesn't know very well, making her seem like a very mysterious girl. However, she is a very kind and compassionate person and always tries to help others when they need it.  Behind all that, however, is a very sweet girl who is just waiting for someone to crack open her shell.
